home.title: SMS Forwarder — Forward incoming SMS to Telegram (Android)
home.subtitle: Automatically forward the text messages your Android phone receives to your Telegram. Leave a phone plugged in at home and get your verification codes and alerts wherever you are.
home.requiresAndroid: Requires Android 8.0 (API 26) or later · Free · For personal use
home.playComingSoon: No server to set up — sign in and start forwarding
home.notVpnTitle: Sign in and go — nothing to set up
home.notVpnDesc: SMS Forwarder is a thin client: it never talks to Telegram directly and holds no channel tokens. Each SMS is relayed through the SMS Forwarder service to your Telegram and then forgotten — message bodies aren't kept after delivery. The app ships ready to connect, so there's nothing to configure.
home.f1Desc: Catches every incoming SMS via a broadcast receiver plus a foreground-service inbox poll — so nothing is missed, even on Huawei / HarmonyOS where background limits break naive SMS apps.
home.f2Desc: Relays each SMS to your Telegram through a shared bot. Binding is one tap — open the bot, press Start; there are no tokens to copy.
home.f3Desc: The backend is already running — no server to stand up and no tokens to paste. Channel routing lives on the server, so channels can change without updating the app.
home.f4Desc: Uploads retry until they succeed and survive reboots; a monotonic message cursor and a server-side idempotency key mean nothing is lost or delivered twice.
home.f5Desc: A persistent foreground service, auto-restart on boot, battery-optimization exemption, an OEM auto-start guide, and an optional silent-audio keep-alive keep it alive on a plugged-in phone.
home.f6Desc: Sign in once and the device stays signed in via a revocable token. Relay-and-forget: message bodies aren't kept after delivery. English and 中文 with an in-app language switch.
home.s1Desc: Create an account in the app and sign in once; the device stays authenticated with a long-lived, revocable token.
home.s2Desc: Tap Bind, open the bot, and press Start. Your Telegram chat is linked to your account — no tokens to copy.
home.s3Desc: Grant SMS + notification permissions and tap Start. The app now watches for every incoming SMS.
home.s4Desc: Each new SMS is relayed through the SMS Forwarder service to your Telegram within seconds — wherever you are.
home.trustDesc: SMS Forwarder holds each message only until it is delivered to your Telegram, then deletes it — only a small delivery log (result, time, sender) is kept. Sign-in uses a per-device token you can revoke at any time, and both the app and the backend are open source.
home.ctaTitle: Get your SMS wherever you are
home.ctaDesc: Download the SMS Forwarder APK, sign in, and start forwarding.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: SMS Forwarder is an SMS-forwarding app for Android, published by ShuttleLab. It reads incoming SMS for one purpose only: to forward them to the Telegram you connect. There are no ads, no analytics, and no tracking SDKs. This policy explains what the app does with your data.
privacyPage.s1Title: What the app reads and why
privacyPage.s1Body: SMS Forwarder reads incoming text messages solely to forward them. It captures new SMS (sender, body, timestamp) and uploads them to the SMS Forwarder backend, which relays them to your Telegram. It does not read, index, or upload anything else on your device.
privacyPage.s2Intro: Messages go only to the SMS Forwarder backend, and from there to the Telegram you set up:
privacyPage.s2a: The backend is operated by ShuttleLab at smsforwarder-api.shuttlelab.org. Message bodies are relayed and then deleted ("relay-and-forget"); only a metadata delivery log (result, time, sender) is kept.
privacyPage.s2b: Delivery to Telegram uses a shared bot; your Telegram chat id is stored on the backend, tied to your account, so your messages reach only you.
privacyPage.s3Body: SMS Forwarder requests only what it needs: Receive/Read SMS (to capture incoming messages), Internet (to upload them), Foreground Service + Notifications (to keep running and show its status), Receive Boot Completed (to restart after a reboot), and battery-optimization exemption (so the OS doesn't freeze it). It is not a VPN and requests no location, contacts, or storage permissions.
privacyPage.s4Body: Signing in creates an account on the backend, identified by a username and a per-device token (stored only as a hash; revocable). Your channel configuration is stored there. Message bodies are not retained after delivery. Delete your account or revoke a device to remove the associated data.
privacyPage.s5Body: SMS Forwarder is a general-purpose utility and is not directed at children.
privacyPage.s6Body: If this policy changes we will update this page and the date above. Questions: support@shuttlelab.org.

termsPage.title: Terms of Use
termsPage.s1Body: By installing or using SMS Forwarder you agree to these terms. It is provided free of charge by ShuttleLab for personal use.
termsPage.s2Body: SMS Forwarder is intended for forwarding your own SMS on devices you control, to destinations you own. Do not use it to intercept or forward messages you are not authorized to access.
termsPage.s3Body: You are responsible for complying with local laws on SMS and messaging, and for the security of your account. SMS Forwarder relays your messages through a service operated by ShuttleLab and is provided as-is.
termsPage.s4Body: SMS Forwarder is provided "as is", without warranties of any kind. Delivery is best-effort and may be delayed or fail; do not rely on it for safety- or security-critical messages.
termsPage.s5Body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, ShuttleLab is not liable for any damages arising from the use of, or inability to use, SMS Forwarder — including any missed or delayed message.
